description: Starts the next year from the open DIYA-GL book: the year end moves on a year with that year's tax rates and the closing balances become the opening ones. Saves it in the person's DIY Accounting Submit account as a new book, which becomes the open one; last year's book is left as it was. Answers the new book's summary and any opening figure that does not agree with last year's closing one. Use this when the person starts a new year. It files nothing.
name: roll_forward
title: Start next year's DIYA-GL book
